steps.en: Install Marker plus an inference backend (vLLM via Docker on GPU, llama.cpp on CPU)
steps.zh: 装 Marker 和推理后端（vLLM 或 llama.cpp）
steps.code: pip install marker-pdf · brew install llama.cpp

steps.en: Point it at one PDF or a whole folder
steps.zh: 指给它一个 PDF 或一整个目录

steps.en: Reads the PDF text layer and detects the layout: columns, tables, headers, figures
steps.zh: 读出 PDF 文字层，识别版面：分栏、表格、页眉、插图

steps.en: Starts a local Surya OCR server and sends it only scanned or garbled pages, equations and shaky tables
steps.zh: 拉起本地 Surya OCR 服务，只送扫描页、乱码页、公式和存疑表格

steps.en: Strips headers/footers, rebuilds tables and writes Markdown/JSON with extracted images
steps.zh: 去掉页眉页脚、重建表格，写出带图片的 Markdown/JSON

value.en: PDFs become clean Markdown with tables and LaTeX math, on your own hardware, ready for RAG or training
value.zh: PDF 在自己的机器上变成带表格和 LaTeX 公式的干净 Markdown，直接喂给 RAG 或训练

sources: https://github.com/datalab-to/marker#installation (pip install marker-pdf, brew install llama.cpp, vLLM via Docker + NVIDIA Container Toolkit)
https://github.com/datalab-to/marker#usage (pdftext text layer, layout model, Surya VLM server spawned on first use, selective OCR)
